prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a vibrant farm harvest scene. On the left, a woman in a blue apron holds a woven basket filled with orange pumpkins. Next to her stands a golden retriever with a red collar, sitting patiently and looking up at her. In the center, a man in a straw hat lifts a heavy wooden crate, his arms extended upward. Beside him, a child in yellow overalls points excitedly toward the right side of the frame. On the right, an elderly person in a green vest leans on a pitchfork, smiling warmly at the child. Behind them, a rustic red barn with white trim anchors the background. The woman hands a small pumpkin to the dog, who gently takes it. The man in the straw hat looks at the child pointing. There is no sky visible in the composition, keeping the focus entirely on the ground-level activity and characters. The scene is bright and colorful, with clean lines defining each figure and object distinctly.
